scenarios.scenario-1: README quickstart and install commands are MAGRA-first.
scenarios.scenario-2: Package metadata points to MAGRA release surfaces or clearly labeled upstream attribution.
scenarios.scenario-3: Unqualified Reasonix branding in primary MAGRA release sections fails docs verification.

evidence-types.evidence-1: Deterministic grep-style assertions inspect README, package metadata, NOTICE, changelog, and release docs.
evidence-types.evidence-2: Trace assertions list each allowed Reasonix attribution or compatibility occurrence.
evidence-types.evidence-3: Integration checks run package build and package-file inclusion checks.

verification-levels.level-2: Run runtime identity tests and release hardening checks.
verification-levels.level-3: Run MyGRACE lint, build, and package smoke before marking Phase-11 done.

telemetry-requirements.telemetry-1: Docs verification reports file path, line number, and classification: primary-brand, attribution, or compatibility.
telemetry-requirements.telemetry-2: Package metadata check reports final package name, bins, repository, bugs, homepage, and files list.

autonomous-safety.safety-1: Autonomous docs edits are safe when they preserve upstream attribution and license notice.
autonomous-safety.safety-2: Any ambiguous license or upstream attribution removal blocks Phase-11 completion.
